node.title: Re^3: Dealing with nextline of a file
node.author: kcott
node.doctext:
"No Tie File esp for bioinformatics"

-- As it stands, this is appalling and irresponsible advice and I urge the OP to disregard it.

  • It immediately struck me as FUD and flame-bait trolling.
  • It's a very lazy response. It lacks any reasoning. You couldn't even be bothered to write [https://perldoc.perl.org/Tie::File|Tie::File] correctly.
  • The OP did not mention "bioinformatics" nor, indeed, did anyone else (at the time of writing).
  • [https://perldoc.perl.org/Tie::File|Tie::File] is a core module: there would be no problems with having to install this from CPAN.
  • The "[https://perldoc.perl.org/Tie::File#DESCRIPTION|Tie::File - DESCRIPTION]" has: "The file is not loaded into memory, so this will work even for gigantic files.".
  • There is a potential memory issue but that can be easily mitigated: see "[https://perldoc.perl.org/Tie::File#memory|Tie::File - memory]".
  • The OP is only reading the file. There is no issue involving the rewriting of records from the point of modification.

— Ken
